meta.title: 4 Days in Northern Vietnam 🇻🇳 The Perfect Itinerary: Hanoi, Ninh Binh & Ha Long Bay
meta.description:
Hello everyone, welcome back to GADT Travel! 👋

Planning a trip to **Northern Vietnam in just 4 days**? 🇻🇳 From the charming streets of Hanoi to the spectacular limestone mountains of Ninh Binh and the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay, this itinerary brings together some of the most unforgettable experiences in northern Vietnam.

In this video, we're taking you on a **4-day Northern Vietnam adventure**, combining local culture, historic landmarks, breathtaking natural scenery, delicious Vietnamese food, and an amazing cruise experience.

✨ Here's what you can experience on this 4-day journey:

🏙️ Explore Hanoi – Wander through the Old Quarter, visit Hoan Kiem Lake, experience the unique Hanoi Train Street, and enjoy the city's lively street food and café culture.

🚣 Discover Ninh Binh – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, take a scenic boat ride through the spectacular limestone landscapes of Trang An, and climb Mua Cave for panoramic views over the rivers and rice fields.

⛵ Cruise through Ha Long Bay – Sail among dramatic limestone islands, enjoy a Vietnamese lunch on board, explore an impressive natural cave, and experience kayaking or a traditional bamboo boat ride, depending on the cruise itinerary and weather conditions.

🏛️ Discover More of Hanoi – If your departure schedule allows, explore Hanoi's historical landmarks, including the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and Temple of Literature, before heading to the airport.

This 4-day Vietnam itinerary is ideal for travelers who want to experience the highlights of Northern Vietnam without spending too much time traveling between destinations. It's a wonderful combination of city life, cultural discoveries, nature, and adventure.

Wondering **what to do in Hanoi, how to explore Ninh Binh, or whether a Ha Long Bay cruise is worth adding to your trip?** Follow along for inspiration and ideas to help plan your Vietnam adventure!

✨ Planning your Vietnam adventure?
